important_scope: Quoted provider rates are factual inputs; candidate counts, review/render/support/fixed-cost budgets are planning assumptions, not measured invoices or a claim of universal best quality.
35% corporate and 45% personal floors are cash reserve policies, not statutory tax rates. Additional reserve is held rather than falsely labelled tax already owed.
C-corp is the calculation assumption. LLC, Korean corporate residence/PE, other states, deductions, owner salary and actual filing positions require a different calculation if applicable.
8% sales-tax collection is an illustration. All collected tax is excluded from revenue and distributable cash; it increases the assumed payment processing fee. It is not a legal blended tax rate.
Extra company-paid candidates are included within a design/selected-scene entitlement; do not charge the same successful regeneration twice in quotas or costs.
The 6-month liquidity target is a company cash balance, not a recurring expense. Reinvestment retention is a separate equity-cash bucket, not an expense deducted twice.
Zero capex/debt and zero opening customer base are explicit scenarios, not statements about the user's existing company.
No paid API call, incorporation, bank transaction, tax filing, deployment, or live charge is performed by this calculator.
